main_text.p: tinet. Hæc propositio est etiam do-ctrina totius Ecclesiæ Reformatæ; speciatim Ecclesiæ orthodoxæ An-glicanæ, ut constat: & omnium eo-rum Theologorum, qui potestatem Magistratus in rebus Ecclesiasticis primatum Regium vocant, item Bullin-geri de Episcoporum Institut. cap 3. f. 71. b. f. 82 a. ubi ex verbo Dei ostendit: Episcopum non debere præferre se Magistratui, ut loquitur. Pareus comment. Rom. p. 1112 [?] pro ridicula petitione principii habet, quod Bel-larm. dixerat, Magistratum in Eccle-siâ non esse primum, sed posteriorem Ec-clesiasticis. vide & Fr. Junium lib. 1. de Pontif. c. 7. Cll. Proff. Leyd. in Synopsi. disputat. 5o. th. 46. docent, ministris Ecclesiæ non deberi æqualem honorem cum Magistratu, tantum abest, ut concedant ipsis plus honoris de-beri. Itidem th. 48. vide & Cl. Ri-vetum, qui p. 256. ait hanc esse do-ctrinam omnium Ecclesiarum & Theo-logorum Reformatorum, & inter alia

page.notes: The running head reads "De Episcopatu". At the top right the printed marker "§. XIII." stands beside it; it is a section mark with a number, so it is not part of the running head. The line "Rom. p. 1112" is hard to read: the digits are spaced and the last figures are doubtful, so "1112" is marked [?]. The word "esse" in "hanc esse doctrinam" has an unusual letter form and is read as "esse". Italic words were identified from the slant of the type; "Pareus" and "Junium" are doubtful as italic or roman. The top line is a fragment ("tinet.") carried over from the previous page. Nothing is printed in the margins or below the text.
